svg.title: From one van reading to an accountable fleet report
svg.desc: Four numbered stages carry a van reading through a unique device credential and narrow publish topic, an IoT rule with a separate IAM stream-write role, a retained stream whose receipt is not business acceptance, and independent alert and analysis consumers. Rule-forwarding failures and consumer-rejected readings require separate owned repair inboxes. This is conceptual design, not tested AWS permission or service behavior.
svg.text: One van reading crosses four promises
A delivery receipt is not yet an accepted maintenance fact.
Unique credential + narrow topic; the body device ID is still a claim.
Separate IAM write role; rule errors need a forwarding inbox.
Partition key + replay window; receipt ≠ business acceptance.
A rejected reading needs a separate business-repair inbox.
Conceptual path: no AWS resource or effective permission tested.
